title: The Taiwan of Hou Hsiao-Hsien and Edward Yang – Taiwan Scene
description:
Jiufen’s Iconic Tea House

Nestled on a ridge overlooking Taiwan’s northeast coast, this multi‑story tea house in Jiufen is clad in dark wood and festooned with red lanterns and Chinese banners reading “阿妹茶樓.” The narrow stairways and balconies bustle with visitors, while potted greenery softens the traditional architecture. 

Famous as a filming location for Hou Hsiao‑Hsien’s A City of Sadness, the tea house retains its historic charm. Open windows reveal cozy interior seating, and the surrounding misty hills hint at the town’s former mining heritage and timeless allure.
